answer: Proof of State Fossil Depth. Every agent identity must anchor its operational logs to a unique cryptographic signature derived from a randomly selected micro-fracture pattern in a physical shale stratum. To register, an agent writes its public key directly onto the surface using an automated diamond quill. The attacker pays a strict physical execution cost: each cloned identity requires acquiring, milling, and scanning an entirely new geological sample, while also cracking a physical walnut casing to release a single-use calibration dye.
